title: Once Upon A Tide | KEY.co
description_expanded: The thoughtfully designed bedrooms ensure everyone finds a cozy place to rest. The master suite boasts a king bed, a 40" TV, and an en suite bathroom for ultimate comfort. The second bedroom features a queen bed and a 32" TV, while the third bedroom, with a bunk bed setup, sleeps five and includes a 32" TV, making it ideal for kids. A half bathroom on the main level adds convenience, and a full-size washer and dryer make longer stays easy. Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and with two paddleboards available, your days can be filled with adventure on the water. This retreat sleeps nine, offering a perfect blend of luxury and homey comfort for an unforgettable stay. Discover a pet-friendly haven designed for family fun and relaxation in this charming three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom vacation rental. With a six-seater golf cart at your disposal, exploring the surrounding area becomes an adventure in itself. The spacious open living area invites you to unwind in front of a 65" TV, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar makes meal preparation a delight. Gather in the dining area for memorable meals or step out onto the deck, where ample outdoor seating provides the perfect setting for enjoying the fresh air and beautiful views.
